title: Perfect Nashville, Quiet, Clean & Near Everything
description:
Welcome to our Nashville Townhouse. This modern style private room is clean & quiet with a ground level entrance & free street parking.  The room is located in a quiet neighborhood yet near all the action & attractions that make Nashville special.  Downtown is 3 miles away. Vanderbilt is 1 mile and Centennial Park is 4 blocks. It's great location and modern feel make it a perfect place to spend a few nights in Nashville.  We live in the upper levels of the townhome and absolutely love the area.

Guest access
Front Porch - Guests have access to the front porch for sitting or smoking. 

Entry hall - once inside the front door. You may use the coat rack and umbrella located in the entry hall.

BNB Room - located just inside the front door.  Door has a chalkboard on the outside of it and a rug outside the door.

Thank you.

During your stay
Feel free to msg me on the AirBNB app or text/call my number provided once you have booked.
